transformations.description: Uses the complete numeric GTFS stop_id/operator idparada as the stable Murcia StopNode suffix and creates a same-code singleton StopPlace for each new identity.
Serializes the frozen unique ordered GTFS stop sequence for main public routes R14 (49 stops) and R20 (36 stops) exactly; both patterns have closesLoop false and no reverse pattern is inferred.
Excludes Cocheras/Cabecera route records from passenger topology under the owner-approved frozen citywide architecture while preserving them in source/provenance artifacts.
Reuses the already accepted canonical es-murcia identity fields exactly and computes only this package local center/bounds from the 72 routed StopPlace coordinates with deterministic framing padding.
Adds exactly one catalog descriptor and recomputes asset and aggregate SHA-256 values from final serialized bytes.

warnings: The archived GTFS is a Transitous processed mirror of the official NAP Transportes de Murcia feed; byte identity with the original NAP ZIP is not claimed.
All 72 component coordinates are either exact accepted Grade A objects (29 reused identities) or Grade B structured GTFS values (43 new identities); no coordinates are inferred or interpolated.
StopNode.sourceReferences is empty because no genuine OpenStreetMap platform or stop_position object was reconciled.

Twenty-nine target stop identities are exact-copied from previously accepted Murcia components and 43 identities are newly created. This fifth component completes coverage of all 206 passenger-routed Murcia stop identities in the frozen prefetch.
All 72 target stops are assigned to the already accepted es-murcia settlement; no cross-municipal evidence occurs in the R14/R20 component.
A later original NAP download is a provenance/source-custody upgrade only; accepted identities must not be silently reconstructed unless an explicit migration is authorized.
